sat-singh.name: Sat Singh
sat-singh.description: Founder of AI Coachella Valley (AICV), delivering AI education in the Coachella Valley since April 2025. Reports the AI beat for the Inland Empire at InformedIE. Runs workshops at the Entrepreneurial Resource Center (ERC) in Palm Desert. Co-organizer of AI Tinkerers Coachella Valley. TEDx Rancho Mirage speaker; previously co-founded a gaming studio acqui-hired by King.com.

hasOccupation.roleName: AI educator and community organizer, Coachella Valley

subjectOf.name: AI, Skynet, and why humans are losing the battle | Sat Singh | TEDxRancho Mirage
subjectOf.description: Artificial Intelligence isn't just disrupting jobs and draining energy — it's quietly rewiring how we think.
